rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=30, batch_size=2, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=112, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-12: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 72->112 (~1.55x; SOLE change vs iter-11; KEEP batch_size=2, itnet_k=1, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, val_n=30, unet_c=24, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). PRIOR RESULT: iter-11 raised batch_size 1->2 and LIFTED val_score 0.9630->0.9694 (val_psnr 41.30 dB, hr 0.454) -- a REAL +0.0064 gain that put v2 ABOVE itnet_v3 (0.9683) and reopened the optimisation-dynamics direction. The earlier ep-saturation diagnosis (iter-6 ep40=0.9648, iter-7 ep56=0.9608, iter-8 ep72=0.9646) was measured entirely at bs=1; it does NOT carry over to bs=2. FAILURE MODE / what is untried: bs=2 HALVES the per-epoch optimizer-step count vs bs=1, so at the SAME pretrain_epochs=72 the model now sees only ~half the gradient updates it saw at bs=1 ep72 -- i.e. ep72@bs2 is roughly ep36-worth of bs1 updates, so the model is UNDER-TRAINED again under the cleaner bs=2 gradient, and the 0.9694 read is a not-fully-converged point, not a ceiling. DEFINITIVE TEST: raise pretrain_epochs 72->112 (restores ~the bs=1 ep72 update budget: 112 bs2-epochs ~ 56 bs1-epochs of steps, while the cleaner bs=2 gradient should let the fit go a bit further) on the otherwise-frozen iter-11 config. HYPOTHESIS: at bs=2 the per-epoch step count is halved so ep72 is under-trained; restoring the optimizer-update budget via ep72->112 under the cleaner bs=2 gradient lifts 0.9694 toward the prior-run ~0.9714 optimum. If it lands flat ~0.969 that documents that the bs=2 gain is epoch-saturated too (next untried axes: bs 2->4, pretrain_lr re-tune at bs=2). WALL GUARD: iter-11 (ep72/bs2/val30) ran 381s; ep112 ~= 381*(112/72) ~= 593s ~= 10 min + val pass -- well under the 15-min cap; val_n=30 kept for the clean read.
